Companion Animal Travel Desk Page Topic: Arrival pickup, transfer, and booking controls. This matters because a pet journey relies on accurate handoffs, clear documentation, and timely actions that protect both animal welfare and service reliability.

As a new staff member at Aurelia Skyways, your job is to follow the desk workflow in the same calm order every time. Start by confirming the arrival pickup steps for the traveler and animal. Arrival pickup is the required form for initiating the correct process, filed as FM-394. Make sure the form is complete before you move on, because downstream checks depend on what is recorded at this stage.

Next, guide your attention to the transfer oversight. Transfer refers to the staffed handoff between process stages, managed by the Records Curator. When you receive a transfer request, keep communication precise: note what has changed, attach the relevant paperwork, and ensure the next responsible staff member can continue without delay.

Finally, you must respect the booking deadline. Booking is the time limit to complete required preparations, set at 84 hours. Treat this as a hard planning boundary, not a target for later; confirm documents early and escalate any issues promptly so the desk can keep the journey on track.

If you have details from the travelers like Talia Chaudhary and Grace Rossi and the pet Willow, record them exactly as provided and keep all entries consistent with the desk records.

Remember: document the arrival pickup correctly, support the transfer handoff, and protect the booking deadline.
